{"text":"ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Show 8 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- HD smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Sandstone; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in accessories for my existing devices than a smart display.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K, brilliant 4K streaming quality, TV and smart home controls, free and live TV; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this to add streaming to my older television, although its 4K capability would not benefit my 720p screen.
ItemID: NA; Title: Blink Video Doorbell | Two-way audio, HD video, motion and chime app alerts, and Alexa enabled — wired or wire-free (White); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not currently looking for a doorbell or home monitoring equipment.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A voice assistant does not address the storage, charging, and camera accessory needs reflected in my recent purchases.
ItemID: NA; Title: Apple AirPods Pro; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current need for wireless earbuds, and my older Apple accessories do not establish compatibility.
ItemID: NA; Title: SanDisk 256GB Extreme microSDXC UHS-I Memory Card with Adapter - Up to 160MB/s, C10, U3, V30, 4K, A2, Micro SD - SDSQXA1-256G-GN6MA; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I frequently buy memory cards and would choose this for extra storage after checking my device supports 256GB microSDXC.
ItemID: NA; Title: Logitech MX Keys Mini Minimalist Wireless Illuminated Keyboard, Compact, Bluetooth, Backlit, USB-C, Compatible with Apple macOS, iOS, Windows, Linux, Android, Metal Build - Graphite; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not looking to change my typing setup right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: WYZE Cam v2 - White; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My camera purchases concern photography accessories, which does not give me a reason to buy a home monitoring camera.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick (3rd Gen) with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) + Star Wars The Mandalorian remote cover (Grogu Green); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Streaming on my television appeals to me, but I would choose the other Fire TV Stick this time and have no particular interest in the themed cover.
ItemID: NA; Title: SSK Aluminum M.2 NVME SATA SSD Enclosure Adapter, USB 3.2 Gen 2 (10 Gbps) to NVME PCI-E SATA M-Key/(B+M) Key Solid State Drive External Enclosure Support UASP Trim for NVME/SATA SSDs 2242/2260/2280; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I use removable memory cards, but I have no identified spare M.2 SSD that would make this enclosure useful."}
